'''Himemiya Shrine''' (ひめみやじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in Ishiki, {{ill|Minamiizu|arz|ميناميزو|ceb|Minamiizu Chō|es|Minamiizu|fa|مینامی‌ایزو|fr|Minamiizu|id|Minamiizu, Shizuoka|it|Minamiizu|ja|南伊豆町|ko|미나미이즈정|ms|Minamiizu, Shizuoka|pl|Minamiizu|ru|Минамиидзу|sv|Minamiizu|tl|Minamiizu, Shizuoka|tr|Minamiizu|uk|Мінамі-Ідзу|ur|منامی اوزو|vi|Minamiizu, Shizuoka|zh|南伊豆町|zh_yue|南伊豆|qid=Q1203741}}, {{ill|Kamo District, Shizuoka|ar|مقاطعة كامو (شيزوكا)|ceb|Kamo-gun (distrito sa Hapon, Shizuoka-ken)|fa|ناحیه کامو، شیزوئوکا|fr|District de Kamo (Shizuoka)|id|Distrik Kamo, Shizuoka|it|Distretto di Kamo (Shizuoka)|ja|賀茂郡|ko|가모군 (시즈오카현)|pl|Powiat Kamo (Shizuoka)|ru|Камо (Сидзуока)|uk|Повіт Камо (Сідзуока)|zh|賀茂郡|qid=Q961511}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}<ref>[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4401123 姫宮神社] - Shizuoka Prefectural Shrine Office</ref>.

=== Overview ===
It is enshrined on the northern mountain foot of the Ishiki district in the central-western part of Minamiizu.

Its founding is unknown, but it is an old shrine identified with the similarly named {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} '''Iwahime-no-Mikoto Shrine''' (いわひめのみことじんじゃ), and is also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no Kuni Shinkaichō|Q17193087|qid=Q17193087}}'' as "Junior Fourth Rank Upper, Iwahime no Myōjin"<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/hime2_title.htm 姫宮神社] - Genbu</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140131-01.html 姫宮神社] - Study of Engishiki Shrines</ref>. In addition, the enshrined Mishima Shrine is treated as a candidate shrine for the {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} '''Takeishitsuki-no-Mikoto Shrine''' (たけいしつきのみことじんじゃ; in the ''Izu no Kuni Shinkaichō'', "Junior Fourth Rank Upper, Takeshi no Myōjin")<ref name="gen"/><ref name="engi"/>.

In {{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}} (Meiji 6), it was listed as a village shrine<ref name="engi"/>.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* Iwahime-no-Mikoto
